prompt:
fix(parser): keep the whole statement when REFRESH falls back to a cmd (#8621)

* fix(parser): keep the whole statement when REFRESH falls back to a command [CLAUDE]

The fallback started the command at the last parsed token rather than at
REFRESH, so e.g. REFRESH DICTIONARY dict_obj was generated as dict_obj and
REFRESH FUNCTION db.func1 as db .func1. It also no longer parses a table
first, which failed on statements like REFRESH CONNECTIONS FORCE.

* Update sqlglot/parser.py

* Update tests/dialects/test_starrocks.py

* Update tests/dialects/test_starrocks.py

---------

Co-authored-by: Trey Spiller <1831878+treysp@users.noreply.github.com>
